explication: Infoooze is a command-line OSINT tool. Users provide a target through flags or the interactive menu; the CLI dispatches to a lookup or reconnaissance module, which gathers and presents findings, with several modules saving results under a local results directory. The README documents a wider feature set than the sampled source excerpts; those capabilities are retained as nodes, but uncertain integrations are not inferred. The graph shows only evidenced dispatches and selected sampled network calls.
